```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(ranger)

df_merged <- read_csv("df_merged.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df_m12    <- read_csv("df_m12_target.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

dt     <- as.data.table(df_merged)
dt_m12 <- as.data.table(df_m12)

feature_cols <- c(
  "is_peak_morning","is_peak_evening","is_peak_noon","is_peak_any","is_night",
  "is_weekend","is_holiday","is_dayoff",
  "station_pressure","temperature","humidity","wind_speed",
  "max_wind_speed","rainfall","solar_radiation",
  "total","inventory","neighbor_inventory_450m"
)

targets  <- c("borrow_count", "return_count", "net_borrow")
stations <- unique(dt$station)

if (!dir.exists("models")) dir.create("models")

set.seed(888)

for (st in stations) {

  train <- dt[station == st]
  test  <- dt_m12[station == st]

  if (nrow(train) < 50 || nrow(test) < 3) next

  for (y in targets) {
    train_y <- train[, c(y, feature_cols), with = FALSE]

    fml <- as.formula(paste(y, "~", paste(feature_cols, collapse = " + ")))

    rf <- ranger(
      formula = fml,
      data    = train_y,
      num.trees = 800,
      importance = "permutation",
      respect.unordered.factors = "order",
      seed = 888
    )

    saveRDS(rf, paste0("models/model_", st, "_", y, ".rds"))
    cat("✔ saved:", st, "/", y, "\n")
  }
}


library(purrr)

get_imp_one <- function(st, y) {
  model_path <- paste0("models/model_", st, "_", y, ".rds")
  if (!file.exists(model_path)) return(NULL)

  rf <- readRDS(model_path)

  vi <- rf$variable.importance
  if (is.null(vi) || length(vi) == 0) return(NULL)

  tibble(
    station    = st,
    target     = y,
    feature    = names(vi),
    importance = as.numeric(vi)
  )
}

df_importance <- map_df(targets, function(y) {
  map_df(stations, function(st) get_imp_one(st, y))
})

glimpse(df_importance)

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ---- 1. 計算「每個 feature 在每個 target」的平均重要性 ----
df_imp_avg <- df_importance %>%
  group_by(target, feature) %>%
  summarise(mean_importance = mean(importance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---- 2. 讓 feature 的排序在三張圖中一致（依 borrow_count 排）----
feature_order <- df_imp_avg %>%
  filter(target == "borrow_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_importance)) %>%
  pull(feature)

df_imp_avg$feature <- factor(df_imp_avg$feature, levels = feature_order)

# ---- 3. 畫 facet 大圖 ----
p <- ggplot(df_imp_avg,
            aes(x = feature, y = mean_importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4A7BB7") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ target, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Feature Importance Across Targets (Permutation Importance)",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Average Importance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

print(p)

ggsave("importance_facet_all_targets.png", p,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```
